verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a full REST API reference (runpod-docs-8, runpod-docs-26) and a probe confirms the OpenAPI spec is live and served at rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json (runpod-probe-rt-4), which is the backbone for an interactive reference. However, there is no direct evidence of a 'try it now' interactive console or embedded runnable code examples within the docs UI itself—only the raw spec and static markdown pages are confirmed. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive Swagger/Redoc-style try-it-out console, runnable code snippets embedded in the docs, and confirmation that the OpenAPI spec is surfaced in the actual docs site rather than only at a separate API host.
